newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Banca Popolare di Novara ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banca Popolare di Novara ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Wednesday it had affirmed Italy's Banca Poplare di Novara (BPN) BBB plus long-term and A2 short-term ratings.
"The bank's individual rating is affirmed at D and its legal rating of 4 is also unchanged," IBCA said in a statement.
The agency said BPN's new management team had implemented a restructuring plan after four loss-making years.

"In 1996, BPN's profitability improved. A number of measures aimed at controlling costs and generating new income should enable the bank to improve core profitability over the next couple of years," IBCA said.

"However, asset quality remains a major weakness of the bank, and is likely to continue to affect its performance in the near future, both in terms of additional loan loss provisions and pressure on net interest margins."
IBCA said BPN remains adequately capitalised with an end-1996 consolidated EU total capital ratio of 10.13 percent, of which 9.72 percent was tier one.--International Bonds Unit +44 171 542 4041
